transform.contacts: socket-layout.json exported from production defs.contact/offset in Factorio 2.0.77; projected at ground coordinates
transform.encoder: RGBA8 filter 0, zlib level 9, no ancillary chunks
transform.monitor: unchanged 64x64 tile/touch area and 60x60 interior; two-unit inner bezel plus four-unit exterior mechanical skirt; 72x72 chamfered artwork; unchanged ground pivot
transform.projection: 64*x - 48*height, 64*z - 128*height; tile units; geometry rotated clockwise before projection; fixed world light
transform.sampling: Pillow integer polygon rasterization; deterministic directional shading, pitting and worn edges; no antialiasing; nearest-neighbour icon fitting
transform.shadow: footprint cast toward world southeast proportional to body height, alpha 85
transform.status: grey dash stopped; amber slash unpowered; green powered; red fault cross; amber/steel four-frame activity
